releases.title: A clearer view of your usage.
releases.summary: Simpler setup, more complete allowance details and a monitor you can move.

sections.title: Getting started
items: A lighter welcome screen with the Llumi app icon.
Turn Codex and Claude Code monitoring on or off during setup and in Settings.
Simpler setup steps with slower installation illustrations.
Check Setup separates sign-in readiness from monitoring availability. Retry explains when another check can run while respecting provider rate limits.

sections.title: Usage and allowances
items: View the supported limits your account reports, with clear labels, remaining percentages and reset times when available.
The compact monitor prioritizes the five-hour limit, then the weekly limit. If neither is reported, it uses another supported time window.
Clearer missing, unsupported, unavailable and stale states. Saved readings are cleared if your account changes or cannot be verified.
Codex and Claude usage cards have equal sizing, clearer light-mode boundaries and consistent provider artwork.

sections.title: Your monitor
items: Drag the monitor to a position that suits you. Llumi saves its position and keeps it within the display.
Expanded details show the supported limits for each provider. Command-1 opens the complete Usage view.

sections.title: Updates
items: One Settings switch enables automatic checking and downloading. With it off, updates remain manual.
Check for Updates checks and downloads an available application update without changing your automatic-update choice.
When a downloaded update is ready, choose Restart and update or Later. Later keeps Llumi running; the prepared update can install when you quit.
After a verified update, Llumi shows a one-time confirmation with a link to that version’s release notes.
Your first update from 1.1.2 uses its existing updater. The new completion popup stays quiet unless installation can be verified.

releases.notice: Unreleased local preview. No public download is available for 1.1.3.

releases.title: In-app updates arrive.
releases.summary: Update support for future macOS releases and clearer Claude usage labels.

sections.title: What's new
items: Adds in-app update support for future macOS releases.
Prevents internal Claude usage bucket names from appearing in the Usage interface.

releases.notice: Existing Llumi 1.1.1 users need to install 1.1.2 manually once. Future compatible macOS updates can then be installed directly from Llumi.
